clue.text: To the younger generation, lower capital has nothing for society

indicators.note: one thing 'for' another stands in its place

parts.note: the standard abbreviation; this S is the one that goes

explanation.surface: A snooty remark that the young think the lower classes of the capital have nothing to offer society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower' looks like the opposite of upper, but it is one that lows; a moo-cow is what small children call a cow.
explanation.definitionFit: A cow lows, so it is a lower, and moo-cow is the nursery word young children use for it.

clue.text: Antipodean case documents uncovered

explanation.definitionFit: Ossie, like Aussie, is informal for an Australian, someone from the Antipodes.

clue.text: Rural nobleman stunned with horror when pet absconds

whoever absconds leaves, so PET is taken out of the word

explanation.surface: A country aristocrat left frozen with fear when the family pet runs off.
explanation.walkthrough: The pet's disappearance is the reason for the horror in the surface, and also the instruction to lift PET from PETRIFIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Countrified means having the manners or look of the countryside, that is rural.

clue.text: Maybe poison militant shortly

explanation.definitionFit: Warfarin is a blood thinner best known as rat poison, so it is one example of a poison.

clue.text: Heads of light entertainment enthralled by past gag

clue.text: Agreeable power mentioned guards

explanation.surface: A pleasant power that has been talked about as a protector.
explanation.walkthrough: SAPID is a rare word for pleasant to the taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapid means having a pleasing flavour, and by extension agreeable.

clue.text: Marine sheet drags — trouble follows

parts.note: to ail is to trouble, as in 'what ails you'

explanation.definitionFit: A lugsail is a four-cornered sail on a slanting yard, a sheet of canvas on a boat.

explanation.definitionFit: A sceptic who doubts a claim is a nonbeliever in it.

clue.text: Traditional newspaper promotion split either side of excessive hype, extremely boring to begin with

clue.text: Mournful English and Gaelic broadcast

scattered about, as seed is broadcast

clue.text: Conservative duffed up one long-haired misfit

clue.text: Eg Russell T Davies's first barren broadcast

clue.text: Checking short month, current account's squeaky clean

clue.text: For some, neat ending when in a stew?

clue.text: Mock frail cat I repeatedly bothered

clue.text: Mechanical sort of grooving tool among electronic drills

explanation.surface: A mechanical kind of grooving tool among some electric drills.

clue.text: Flower arranging in general mostly trite

explanation.walkthrough: 'In general' reads as 'on the whole'; 'in' is a link and 'general' is Ike.

clue.text: Duke escapes poverty crushing utter dope

clue.text: Fairly good Hispanic cheer ahead of Republican being welcomed by panel

indicators.note: taken in by the outer word

explanation.walkthrough: A panel of experts is a table in the sense of a round-table discussion.

clue.text: Soldiers protected by cover step up

clue.text: Peak fitness upped jogging intensity primarily
